content.simple_explanation: 'Gilli Danda' is studied by first understanding the main idea, then noticing the evidence, examples and relationships in the chapter.
study_steps: Explain them in your own words.
key_points: 7979 Gilli Danda 7 Gilli Danda Let us Recite In the playground, we gather around, With a stick and a small gilli to throw, Gilli Danda, our game is so sound!
One, two, three, swing and hit, With our friends, we never quit!
With every swing, we feel so free, Oh, what fun it is, you see!
The small gilli, up high it flies, Underneath the bright blue skies.
Laughing, playing, having fun, Under the golden rays of the sun!
